messages:
ana: Quick thoughtwe need clearer client-facing error categories for routing/quota degradations. Propose a tiny enum: soft | sticky | terminal. Header + optional body field + telemetry tag.

matt: Agree. Header name? x-rd-error-ephemerality? Keep it short.

sophie: SDKs should show human hints: soft -> retry backoff; sticky -> consider reduced concurrency/dedicated; terminal -> surface runbook link.

ryan: Console mapping: soft=amber degraded (sampled), sticky=red restricted (fully sampled + runbook), terminal=red+alert. Also add a sample-id header for triage.

ana (ana): Minimal example:
HTTP/1.1 503
x-rd-error-kind: route
x-rd-error-ephemerality: soft
{ "error": { "code": "route_degraded", "message": "fallback applied", "ephemerality": "soft" } }

matt: Rollout plan - flag runtime emission, then telemetry, then SDKs, then console. Nonbreaking: header-only first.

sophie: Add escalation rule: if fallback used >5s escalate soft->sticky and emit telemetry event.

ryan: Action items: ana - RFC, matt - SDK mapping PR, infra - alert rule, sophie - console mockups. We'll iterate on wording in the RFC.
